items.title: How a page with ads loads for a visitor
steps: The page content starts to show
The ad slots ask for ads
Bids come back before the timeout
The ads show and viewability is measured
items.why: Consent comes first, then content, then the auction, then measurement.

items.title: How a publisher fixes a slow page
steps: Find the slowest scripts and ads
Reserve space for the ad slots
Lazy load ads below the fold
items.why: Measure, fix the biggest causes, and measure again to confirm.
